## Goal
Customers can move or cancel bookings safely: caller ID is a hint, not proof.

## Owns
- `services/tool-api/src/handlers/reschedule-booking.ts`
- `services/tool-api/src/handlers/cancel-booking.ts`
- `services/tool-api/src/lib/booking-lifecycle.ts`
- `services/tool-api/src/lib/verification.ts`
- `services/tool-api/test/booking-lifecycle.test.ts`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- customer-agent without verificationCode -> 403 with a natural sayToCaller asking for name + day.
- issueVerification(callId, bookingId) when name and booked day match; code bound to callId, 10-min TTL.
- Reschedule moves slot locks atomically (old deleted, new put, one transaction); conflict -> 409.
- Cancel releases locks, idempotent, emits booking.cancelled.

## Steps
- Put DynamoDB access in lib/booking-lifecycle.ts (do not edit repo.ts).

- Tests green; no tenant id read from body.
